q1.q: What payment methods do you accept?
q1.a: We accept Orange Money, MTN Mobile Money. Payment is instant and secure via Fapshi.

q2.a: We accept PayPal in Euro (€), US Dollar ($), British Pound (£) and Canadian Dollar (CA$). Payment is secure and currencies are automatically converted. The transaction is manually validated by our team after receiving the transfer.

q3.q: What is Minipay and which countries are supported?
q3.a: Minipay is a mobile payment solution available in over 40 African countries. At KermHosting, we currently support: Cameroon, Ivory Coast, Senegal, Mali, Burkina Faso, Benin, Niger, Togo, Gabon, Congo, Chad, Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Tanzania, Uganda, Rwanda, South Africa, Morocco, Algeria, Tunisia and more to come! You pay in your local currency with a simple screenshot upload.

q4.q: How does the coins system work?
q4.a: Coins are our virtual currency. You can buy them in FCFA, via PayPal or Minipay and get discounts. 100 coins = 500 FCFA, with bonuses depending on the packs.

q5.q: Can I use my own domain name?
q5.a: Yes! You can configure your own domain names for your servers. We also provide free subdomains.

q6.q: What happens when my server expires?
q6.a: You receive an email 3 days before expiration. If you don't renew, the server is automatically deleted after 3 days.
